scope: Approved dev-based maintained suite. A mapped file supplies evidence for a slice, not blanket completion of the numbered check or platform qualification. Wiki and Automations excluded.

checks.intended_behavior: Chat reply stays in Chat, command output stays in the work log, and retrying a send does not duplicate work.
A delayed save response cannot erase newer typing or another tab’s unsent draft.
An explicitly attached file is readable on the Agent’s next turn, and another Chat cannot access it.
Taking manual browser control stops Agent actions; resuming automation keeps the same browser session.
checks.coverage_limits: Opt-in actual Chrome navigation, fill/click, selected file bytes, no form submission, PNG capture and owned shutdown. Linux additionally exercises native manual pause/resume with unchanged process/page contents. Mac is headless: native Mac UI/manual control unqualified. Server artifact/grant authorization pipeline and other device cases remain separate.

checks.intended_behavior: A plain Chat request goes to the selected responsible Agent; choosing a new Agent creates the intended recipient.
checks.coverage_limits: Routing helper only; selected-recipient/new-Agent UI remains manual.

checks.intended_behavior: Renaming an Agent does not change who receives messages addressed to its stable identity.
A direct message reaches only its explicitly selected Agent recipients.
Each direct-message recipient receives only the attachments intended for that recipient.
A fresh unrelated Agent does not inherit private direct messages or private files.
Team Chat shows collaboration separately from ordinary shared Chat.
An unavailable recipient produces honest delivery feedback; retry does not send the same message twice.
Delivery receipts distinguish accepted work from an actual completed reply.
Loading older messages and following a message link finds the correct message without duplicating it.
Recovered drafts preserve their text, recipient selections and staged attachments in the correct Chat.
Restoring or discarding one recovered draft does not alter another Chat’s draft.
Losing the send response preserves the exact pending submission instead of creating a second request.
A newly started provider session can read an explicitly attached file.
After server close/reopen, explicitly referencing an earlier attachment still supplies its correct bytes.
Photo and folder uploads preserve the submitted contents and respect the existing upload limits.
checks.coverage_limits: PNG original bytes plus independently validated folder ZIP and input limits; real camera/folder-picker UI remains manual.

checks.intended_behavior: Long pasted text reaches the intended request without truncation or replacement by the wrong attachment.

Provider error text is shown as an error, rather than being listed as an installed MCP tool.
Unknown or disabled provider commands are refused without performing the requested action.
An approved provider command executes only within its granted Agent and Run scope.
